info.title: Rust Spell Server
info.description: A production-ready Rust HTTP server exposing a spell-checking API over OpenAPI-compliant endpoints.

post.description: Creates a new `admin` or `standard` key scoped to the caller's own tenant. The raw key value is returned exactly once.

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired, or revoked key

403.description: Key does not have the admin role

429.description: Too many failed authentication attempts from this IP

get.description: Returns metadata for all keys belonging to the caller's own tenant. Raw and hashed values are never returned.

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired, or revoked key

403.description: Key does not have the admin role

delete.description: Soft-revokes a key belonging to the caller's own tenant. Idempotent: revoking an already-revoked key still returns 204.

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired, or revoked key

403.description: Key does not have the admin role

404.description: Unknown key id, or the id belongs to a different tenant

post.description: Issues a new raw value for an existing key, invalidating the previous value. The id, label, and role are unchanged; the raw key is returned exactly once.

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired, or revoked key

403.description: Key does not have the admin role

404.description: Unknown key id, or the id belongs to a different tenant

get.description: Returns the OpenAPI 3.0 JSON document describing this API.
Public endpoint returning the union of locally cached dictionaries and registered dictionary source URLs. No API key required.

post.description: Registers a new dictionary locale and source URL template, persists it, then downloads and caches the `.aff`/`.dic` pair so the language is immediately available. Restricted to `platform` keys and, when configured, callers from `RUSTSPELL_DICTIONARY_ADMIN_CIDRS`.

400.description: Validation error (invalid language code or non-http(s) source URL), or the language could not be downloaded/parsed.

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired, or revoked key

403.description: Key is not `platform`, request carries an `Origin` header, or caller IP is outside the configured admin CIDRs

429.description: Too many failed authentication attempts from this IP

get.description: Returns service liveness status. Use `?verbose=true` for runtime metrics.

post.description: Accepts text and/or an explicit word list and returns one result per token occurrence.

400.description: Validation error (neither `text` nor `words` provided, or malformed `language`), or `language` is a well-formed but unloadable code (download/parse failure).

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired, or revoked key

429.description: Rate limited or over quota. Two distinct causes share this status: too many failed authentication attempts from this IP (`type` ends in `rate-limited`, retries after `Retry-After` seconds), or the tenant's request quota is exhausted for the current billing period (`type` ends in `quota-exceeded`, no `Retry-After` — resolved by the platform/billing app via `PATCH /tenants/{id}`, not by waiting).

post.description: Returns unique misspelled tokens and their char positions in the provided text.

400.description: Validation error (neither `text` nor `words` provided, or malformed `language`), or `language` is a well-formed but unloadable code (download/parse failure).

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired, or revoked key

429.description: Rate limited or over quota. Two distinct causes share this status: too many failed authentication attempts from this IP (`type` ends in `rate-limited`, retries after `Retry-After` seconds), or the tenant's request quota is exhausted for the current billing period (`type` ends in `quota-exceeded`, no `Retry-After` — resolved by the platform/billing app via `PATCH /tenants/{id}`, not by waiting).

get.description: Returns metadata for the calling key's own tenant. Callable by `admin` or `standard` keys (read-only self-service usage visibility).

post.description: Registers a browser origin for the caller's own tenant, enabling CORS and passing server-side origin binding for that origin.

get.description: Per-day request count, average latency, and error count. Always returns dated rows; the window only bounds the range. A `platform` key returns cross-tenant aggregates; an `admin` key returns its own tenant only. `standard` keys are rejected.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Inclusive start of the window, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Must be supplied together with `end`. Omitting both selects the caller's billing period (admin key) or the last 30 days (platform key).

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Inclusive end of the window, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Must be supplied together with `start`.

200.description: Usage aggregates for the resolved window. An empty array before any data accumulates.

400.description: Malformed, inverted, half-supplied, or over-retention date range

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired, or revoked key

403.description: `standard` key, suspended tenant, unregistered origin, or a `platform` key carrying an `Origin` header

get.description: Counts grouped by HTTP status and error slug. Only errors produced by the spellcheck handlers appear; auth, suspension, and quota rejections are stopped by middleware before the request is recorded. A `platform` key returns cross-tenant aggregates; an `admin` key returns its own tenant only. `standard` keys are rejected.

label.description: Human-readable name to distinguish this key from others.

expires_at.description: Unix-epoch seconds. Omit for a key that never expires.

quota_limit.description: Max /spellcheck* requests per billing period. 0 or omitted means unlimited.

CreatedApiKeyResponse.description: `ApiKeyMetadata` plus the raw key value, returned exactly once (on creation or rotation).

key.description: Raw key value. Not persisted, not retrievable again — save it now.

CreatedTenant.description: `TenantMetadata` plus its first admin key, returned exactly once.

date.description: Present only when an explicit `start`/`end` window was supplied.

error_code.description: Error slug, identical to the tail of the RFC 7807 `type` URI.

date.description: Present only when an explicit `start`/`end` window was supplied.

cached.description: Whether the `.aff`/`.dic` files are present in the local cache.

registered.description: Whether a source URL template is persisted for this locale.

code.description: Locale code used as the cache directory name and substituted into the source URL template.

source_url.description: Base URL template from which `{code}.aff` and `{code}.dic` are downloaded. Must be http(s).

date.description: Present only when an explicit `start`/`end` window was supplied.

positions.description: Zero-based character positions of the misspelled token in the provided `text`. Empty when the token was supplied only via `words`.

origin.description: A bare http(s) origin with no path, e.g. https://app.example.com.

Role.description: `platform` also exists internally but is never accepted or returned by these endpoints — it's only ever bootstrap-created.

SpellCheckRequest.description: Request body for spell-check endpoints. At least one of `text` or `words` must be provided.

text.description: Free-form text to tokenize and spell-check

words.description: Explicit list of words to spell-check

language.description: Overrides the calling tenant's default language for this request. Downloaded and cached on first use if not already loaded; an unloadable language returns 400, not 500.

request_count.description: Resets the tenant's request count, e.g. to 0 on a billing period rollover.

period_start.description: Omit to leave unchanged, null to clear, a number to set.

period_end.description: Omit to leave unchanged, null to clear, a number to set.
